urls.title: Video URLs
urls.description: TikTok, YouTube / Shorts, or Instagram Reels URLs (or raw IDs). Instagram rows are recorded but not billed — public pages do not expose view counts without a login.

defaultRatePer1k.title: Default $ per 1,000 views
defaultRatePer1k.description: Used to compute estimatedPayoutUsd = views / 1,000 × rate. Leave empty to only collect stats.

urlRates.title: Per-URL rates (optional)
urlRates.description: Override the default CPM for specific URLs.

url.title: URL
url.description: TikTok, YouTube, Shorts or Instagram URL (or raw ID).

ratePer1k.title: $ per 1,000 views
ratePer1k.description: Override CPM in USD for this URL.

maxItems.title: Max posts
maxItems.description: Cap on URLs processed (and charged) in this run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many post URLs to fetch in parallel (1–10).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: YouTube often blocks cloud IPs (LOGIN_REQUIRED). Leave the default Apify datacenter proxy on for platform runs. Do not enable residential groups unless a run is still blocked.
